name: v1.0.18 — Fix Quick Share Crash & Polish Google Stitch Aesthetics
body:
## 🌸 Kids OS v1.0.18 Release Notes

### ⚡ Quick Share Crash Fixed & Tested
- **Resolved FrameLayout ClassCastException**: Fixed a crash caused by `tv_share_file_selected` being styled as a FrameLayout checkmark badge while the Java ViewHolder was expecting a `TextView`, which previously triggered an ANR freeze on launch.
- **Uncaught Exception Forwarding**: Properly delegated unhandled exceptions to the system default handler rather than silently deadlocking the main looper.
- **Direct Camera Directory Scanning**: Enhanced `loadCategoryFiles` to scan `Pictures/MelodyCamera` and `DCIM/Camera` directly alongside MediaStore so kid artwork and photos are instantly discoverable.
- **Google Stitch Kawaii Polish**: Polished Squircle card gloss so pastel CardView macaron backgrounds shine cleanly, refined Parent Zone card borders and contrast.
